newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market higher tone - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market higher tone - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers had a higher undertone noted in a light test, compared to Monday's close, USDA said.
Trade was mostly slow and demand light to moderate. Seller interest and offerings were light.
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200 lbs 2 pt lds 64.25. Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1150 lbs few 64.25-65.00.
Carcass Basis (weight only), compared with Monday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were firm in a light test.

Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1250 lbs 1.5 ld 105.00. Holstein: (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs few 101.00 ld 102.00. Holsteins: ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales. Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales.
Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1150 lbs few 105.00.
Wk to Date: 2,500 Week Ago: 19,800 Year Ago: 8,700
